header.title: Match Center
header.loadFailed: The fixture could not be loaded.

awaitingResult: This fixture kicked off {when} and is still recorded as {status}. The live follower and the results sync should have moved it on; check System / Admin for a failing job.

result.title: Result
result.noScore: No score has been recorded for this fixture.
result.notPlayed: Not played ({status}): there is no result to record.
result.inPlay: In play: the live score is shown above and in the In-play tab. The result is recorded at full time.
result.awaiting: Kicked off, but no result has been recorded yet.
result.scheduled: Scheduled. The result is recorded after full time.

fixture.title: Fixture
fixture.noRound: The provider did not report a round.
fixture.noVenue: The provider did not identify the venue.

captured.title: Captured prices
captured.subtitle: Latest price per bookmaker that THIS platform captured. Implied probability is 1/odds: the bookmaker margin is still in it.

historical.title: Historical market
historical.subtitle: Published by a second source after the fact. Kept apart from our captures, never mixed into them.

models.title: Model predictions
models.subtitle: Probabilities with their data cut-off. Probability is not confidence; the interval is the model's own parameter uncertainty (90%, Laplace).
models.backtestNote: These were produced by the walk-forward backtest, using only results public before each cut-off. They are not forecasts that were published before the match.
models.only1x2: Only the 1X2 baseline is shown here.
models.noBtts: The source publishes no BTTS prices.
models.notPriced: This model does not price this market.
models.noInterval: No interval was computed for this prediction.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: What the system observed for this fixture, in order. Windows the plan cannot reach are marked, not counted as missed.

code.window_free_plan: Out of reach on the free plan
code.window_provider_empty: Asked at T-{minutes} min: the provider had no prices for this match
code.window_missed: The window passed without a capture
code.extra_capture: {quotes} quotes captured at T-{minutes} min (outside the windows)
code.near_close_done: Captured at T-{minutes} min (not a validated closing line)
code.near_close_off: Off by design: the closing reference is the last pre-match price, read after the match
code.kickoff_by_result: Played: the provider recorded the result
code.kickoff_unconfirmed: Kick-off time passed; the provider has not confirmed the start
code.final_prematch: {quotes} last pre-match quotes from {bookmakers} bookmakers (the closing reference)
code.result_not_played: No result: the match was not played
code.result_abandoned: No result: the match was abandoned
code.result_suspended: Suspended: waiting for the provider to resume or close it
code.result_provider_pending: The provider still reports "{status}": we wait and keep asking
code.result_provider_silent: No word from the provider since it should have ended
code.result_jobs_stalled: Our result jobs are not running
code.result_result_missing: Finished, but no score is stored
code.result_provider_conflict: The provider contradicts itself (finished, with its kick-off ahead)

outcome.after_kickoff: the provider only had prices updated after kick-off (not usable as a close)

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.subtitle: From the provider's bytes to the row on screen
lineage.providerDetail: Fixture {id} as the provider identifies it.
lineage.payloadDetail: {endpoint} {params}, stored gzipped and indexed by its hash.
lineage.runDetail: Written by {job}; see the job ledger.
lineage.noRun: No run linked to this row.
lineage.rowDetail: Normalised row. Writes are monotonic on the payload fetch time: an older payload never overwrites a newer one.
lineage.scoreFromPayload: The score was read from this payload.
lineage.scoreBeforeLineage: Score written before lineage was recorded (revision 0015).

stats.title: Team statistics
stats.asOfLive: As of {when} — updated every minute while the match is played.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Goals, cards, substitutions and VAR decisions as the provider reports them.

players.noName: The provider did not name the player.
players.notRated: Not rated (too few minutes or not reported).

table.title: League table
table.subtitle: The last table we hold before kick-off for both sides.
table.noForm: The provider gave no form string.
table.snapshotAfterKickoff: Snapshot {when} — taken AFTER kick-off, it includes this match.

form.title: Recent form
form.subtitle: Last six finished matches before this one, any competition.

h2h.title: Head to head
h2h.subtitle: Previous meetings with a stored result.

absences.title: Absences
absences.subtitle: Injuries and suspensions the provider reported for this match.

live.note: In-play data is a separate system from the pre-match prices: it is never used to judge, train or backtest a pre-match model, and the last in-play price is not a closing line. In-play odds are shown while the match is played and not kept afterwards.

states.title: Match state over time
states.subtitle: Each change of status, minute or score from the fixture feed, and the odds feed's current state while the match is in play.

quotes.title: In-play prices
quotes.subtitle: The current price of each selection (no bookmaker dimension in this feed). Emptied when the match ends.
quotes.withdrawnReason: Withdrawn by the bookmaker at this instant.
quotes.others_one: {count} more in-play price belongs to a bet with no market of ours; it is not shown.
quotes.others_other: {count} more in-play prices belong to bets with no market of ours; they are not shown.

movement.title: Price movement
movement.subtitle: The last change of each selection in our markets while the match is played, newest first: moves and suspensions.

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: Provider → raw payload → normalised rows → features → model → prediction → market → pick → settlement, from stored hashes and ids only
audit.complete: Chain complete: nothing expected is missing
audit.gaps_one: {count} step with a gap: {steps}. Each says why below.
audit.gaps_other: {count} steps with a gap: {steps}. Each says why below.
